newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican priest missing after kidnap ransom paid.
newsitem.headline: Mexican priest missing after kidnap ransom paid.

text.p: Mexico's Catholic Church issued an appeal on Wednesday for the release of an aged Jesuit priest kidnapped last month who is still missing even though his ransom was paid 10 days ago.

Wilfredo Guinea, 74, editor of a church publication, was abducted on June 17 in Mexico City and church officials said a ransom was delivered five days later, though they declined to reveal how much it was.
"The ransom was paid, but we still no nothing about the whereabouts of Father Guinea, a spokesman for Mexico's Archbishopric told Reuters.
"We retiterate our condemnation of this act and appeal to the conscience of his captors," he added.
Guinea's colleagues said he suffered from a weak heart.
